craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta of landing — rest, fulfillment, no-other-standing; autonomy dawning mid-proof. Four-offices catalogue (order/ground/winning/winding-up); double-concomitance frame kept with the Vṛ (BOUNDARY). Rejected: (a) trimming catalogue → killed: offices are content. (b) bare-mūla the-other → killed: Vṛ-reading settled at L0 grounds. Read aloud: BY-part-ing AND-by-PAIR-ing-BOTH … OF the-OTH-er IN-ert-SELVES.

lines: By parting and by pairing both, assurance stands declared —
fixed order, ground, attainment, full close — of the other inert selves.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vyatireketarābhyām hi niścayo 'nyajaḍātmanoḥ vyavasthitiḥ pratiṣṭhā ca siddhir nirvṛttir ucyate

reads_against.argmap: What orders the inert selves? → Certainty's four offices — order, ground, winning, winding-up — govern inert selves through double concomitance.
c1_essence: What never stood cannot stand another: consciousness fits itself to this and I, orders inert selves by double certainty, and completes severed grasping in self-rest (vv10-15).
The same self twofold — breath-bound atom, unbroken whole — gathers in one continuous end-ground where nothing shows more inert than shining (vv16-18).
